channel.title: Newspin: latest timeline updates
channel.description: Newspin turns the biggest ongoing news stories in India, the US and around the world into clear, sourced timelines: what happened, when, and what comes next.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Jensen Huang resigns; CFO Colette Kress becomes interim CEO
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · After a board meeting on Wednesday night, Nvidia says its co-founder has stepped down as chief executive. Chief financial officer Colette Kress takes over on an interim basis, and venture investor Harvey C. Jones becomes the company’s first board chair. The board is reported to be looking at outside candidates for the permanent role. Investigations by the FBI and Congress, and a shareholder class-action lawsuit, continue.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: New report alleges a second relationship, with a senior Nvidia executive
item.description: 11 Nov 2026 · The New York Times reports, citing five employees, that Huang is also suspected of a relationship with a married executive who reports directly to him. Nvidia has rules discouraging relationships between managers and subordinates. This is a reported allegation; Nvidia’s response had not been published in the coverage we reviewed. Analysts have started asking whether Huang could be forced to step aside, with no public succession plan.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Former US attorney and Wachtell Lipton hired to run the inquiry
item.description: 10 Nov 2026 · The board names Joon Kim, a former acting US Attorney, and the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to lead the independent investigation. Nvidia’s losses since Monday reach close to $500 billion in market value, according to NBC News.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Shares slide; China rejects the claims
item.description: 9 Nov 2026 · Nvidia falls as much as 8% in early trading before recovering to about 4% down, while rivals AMD and Broadcom rise. China’s Foreign Ministry calls the allegations unsubstantiated. Huang pulls out of an AI industry CEO forum.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Board opens independent investigation; Huang admits infidelity
item.description: 8 Nov 2026 · A committee of independent directors with outside counsel will review the reports. The board says it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised and that it has confidence in Huang, who stays CEO. In a message to staff, Huang says he was unfaithful to his wife and will cooperate fully. President Trump calls him an honourable man and says he has not discussed the matter with him.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Incoming Democratic majority signals its own questions
item.description: 6 Nov 2026 · Bloomberg reports that the new Democratic majority in Congress is set to demand answers from Nvidia on keeping its AI chips out of China. The new Congress sits from 3 January.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: House committee chairs ask Huang for a closed-door briefing
item.description: 4–5 Nov 2026 · Three Republican House committee chairs ask Huang to brief them on 18 November about his contacts with the Megaspeed executive and Nvidia’s protections against espionage, with a reply due by 11 November. The letter comes a day after midterms in which Republicans lost control of Congress.

item.title: US trade deal: Still no signed deal
item.description: 3 Nov 2026 · The 18% rate announced in February was never applied. After the US midterms, Indian trade analysts argue an early interim deal has become more likely.

item.title: Digi Yatra: International trials begin at seven airports
item.description: 1 Nov 2026 · Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kochi, Mumbai, Chennai and Amritsar start trials for Indian e-passport holders on select Air India and IndiGo flights.

item.title: Budget 2027: Half-year deficit runs ahead of last year
item.description: 30 Oct 2026 · The deficit for April–September reaches ₹7.14 lakh crore, about 25% higher than a year earlier and 42.1% of the full-year target, compared with 36.5% at the same point last year.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: New York Times report: Huang targeted by Chinese intelligence
item.description: 29 Oct 2026 · US intelligence agencies found Huang had developed a close relationship with an executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed, one of Nvidia’s biggest Southeast Asian customers, whom US officials concluded was gathering information for Beijing. Officials did not believe Huang knew. Nvidia said the interactions were a normal part of his job. China called the claims baseless smears.

item.title: Inflation: September inflation jumps to 5.54%
item.description: 12 Oct 2026 · Food inflation climbs to 7.74%. Rural inflation, at 6.08%, runs well above urban inflation at 4.88%.

item.title: Budget 2027: Pre-Budget meetings with ministries begin
item.description: 12 Oct 2026 · Meetings chaired by the Expenditure Secretary start working out each ministry’s spending for 2027-28 and revised figures for this year. They were scheduled to run until 13 November.

item.title: Inflation: RBI hikes rates and raises its inflation forecast
item.description: 7 Oct 2026 · The RBI raises the repo rate to 5.50% and lifts its 2026-27 inflation projection to 5.2% from 5%.

item.title: RBI rates: RBI raises rates for the first time since February 2023
item.description: 7 Oct 2026 · A unanimous 0.25-point hike to 5.50%. The stance shifts to “calibrated tightening” on a 4–2 vote, which signals that rate cuts are off the table for now.

item.title: Rupee: Hovering near record lows ahead of the RBI decision
item.description: 6 Oct 2026 · The rupee trades around 96.4 per dollar. The RBI keeps selling dollars to slow the fall, and markets price in a rate hike.

item.title: RBI rates: Inflation jumps
item.description: Jul–Sep 2026 · Retail inflation averages 4.9% in July–September, up from 3.9% the quarter before. Wholesale inflation tops 10%.

item.title: Digi Yatra: International trials announced
item.description: 22 Sep 2026 · Plans are set for trials at major airports between October and December 2026.

item.title: US trade deal: US sanctions law threatens tariffs of up to 100%
item.description: 18 Sep 2026 · A new US law authorises tariffs of up to 100% on the five largest buyers of Russian oil and gas, naming India and China as at direct risk.

item.title: Russian oil: US law names India at risk of tariffs up to 100%
item.description: 18 Sep 2026 · The new sanctions law targets the five largest buyers of Russian oil and gas.

item.title: FCRA bill: Home Ministry briefs the committee
item.description: 18 Sep 2026 · The panel begins detailed examination after a briefing from the Ministry of Home Affairs.

item.title: Inflation: August inflation at 4.8%, above the RBI’s 4% target
item.description: 12 Sep 2026 · Higher food prices push inflation above the target for a fourth month running. The figure was later revised to 4.83%.

item.title: West Asia & oil: Brent nears $100 again
item.description: 3 Sep 2026 · A fresh escalation in the US–Iran conflict renews fears for Gulf supplies, with Hormuz shipping still severely disrupted.

item.title: FCRA bill: Committee formed, chaired by Sanjay Jaiswal
item.description: 3 Sep 2026 · The joint committee is constituted with BJP MP Sanjay Jaiswal as chair.

item.title: Budget 2027: Work on Budget 2027-28 begins
item.description: 27 Aug 2026 · The Finance Ministry issues the Budget Circular 2027-28, asking ministries to submit estimates by 6 October for meetings starting 12 October. It will be Sitharaman’s 10th straight Budget, and may need to make room for the 8th Pay Commission.

item.title: West Asia & oil: Oil back above $90
item.description: 21 Aug 2026 · A US–Iran deadlock keeps Hormuz disrupted, raising India’s import bill and pressure on the rupee.

item.title: FCRA bill: Sent to a joint committee amid protests
item.description: 12 Aug 2026 · After opposition parties and minority groups demand its withdrawal, the Lok Sabha refers the bill to a 31-member joint parliamentary committee.

item.title: RBI rates: Fifth hold in a row; RBI wants more clarity on inflation
item.description: 5 Aug 2026 · The MPC holds unanimously and says it needs more clarity on the path of inflation before acting.

item.title: US trade deal: A new 10% duty on most Indian goods
item.description: 24 Jul 2026 · A Section 301 duty of 10% starts applying to most Indian imports into the US, becoming the main sticking point in talks.

item.title: Russian oil: Russian crude imports reach a reported record
item.description: Apr–Jun 2026 · India’s Russian crude intake is reported at a record 2.25 million barrels a day, and about 70% of its crude now avoids Hormuz.

item.title: FCRA bill: Separate FCRA Rules, 2026 come into force
item.description: 22 Jun 2026 · Revised rules are notified and take effect. They are distinct from the amendment bill, which is still pending.

item.title: West Asia & oil: Ceasefire news brings relief
item.description: 15 Jun 2026 · Brent falls about 4% to around $84 on news of a ceasefire and hopes that Hormuz shipping will normalise.

item.title: Digi Yatra: Passes 100 million journeys
item.description: Jun 2026 · An IATA-led trial shows Digi Yatra can work with global systems and with Apple and Google wallets.

item.title: RBI rates: Two more holds as energy prices climb
item.description: Apr–Jun 2026 · On 8 April and 5 June the RBI stays put, citing global uncertainty and elevated energy prices linked to the West Asia conflict.

item.title: Budget 2027: Last year’s deficit target met, but April’s deficit nearly doubles
item.description: May 2026 · Official accounts show the 2025-26 fiscal deficit target of 4.4% of GDP was met. But April 2026 alone used 21% of this year’s target, unusually high for the first month, as fuel-tax cuts hit receipts.

item.title: Rupee: Through 96 as oil surges
item.description: 18 May 2026 · The rupee hits 96.25 in early trade after closing below 96 for the first time the previous Friday. Foreign investors pulled nearly $20 billion from Indian equities in the first four months of 2026.

item.title: Online gaming: Rules take effect; real-money games banned
item.description: 1 May 2026 · The authority goes live. It classifies games as money games, social games or esports, with a 90-day determination process. Esports certificates can last up to 10 years.

item.title: West Asia & oil: Blockade continues as peace talks stall
item.description: 23–24 Apr 2026 · Brent trades at $102.40 on 23 April and above $106 the next day.

item.title: Online gaming: Gaming Rules notified; regulator set up
item.description: 22 Apr 2026 · The IT ministry notifies the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Rules, 2026 and constitutes a six-member Online Gaming Authority of India.

item.title: Digi Yatra: Contactless international trial with IATA in Bengaluru
item.description: 9 Apr 2026 · IndiGo, Digi Yatra, Bengaluru airport and IATA complete technical trials of an integrated contactless international travel project.
